_note: Child-facing replies. Plain words, never case details. Luganda version (messages_lg.json) needs a native-speaker review before use.
menu: Habari: you are not in trouble. Reply 1 Danger 2 Asked for pics or money 3 Adult hurting me 4 Mean or fake 5 Upsetting online
menu_retry: Please reply with a number from 1 to 5. 1 Danger 2 Asked for pics or money 3 Adult hurting me 4 Mean or fake 5 Upsetting online
describe: Tell us what happened in one message, any language. Reply 0 to skip.
received: Thank you. It is not your fault. Case {code}. A person will help. STATUS {code} to check. STOP to erase.
danger: Call {helpline} now, it is free. You are not in trouble. A person is coming to help. Case {code}. STATUS {code} to check.
added: Thank you. We added this to case {code}. A person will see it.
status_unknown: We could not find that code. Please check it and try again.
status_need_code: Send STATUS and your case code, for example STATUS HB-ABC234.
status_need_pin: Please send STATUS {code} and your word.
pin_saved: Your word is saved. Next time send STATUS, your code and your word.
pin_need_word: Send PIN and a secret word, for example PIN mango.
stopped: Done. We will not message you again. Please delete these messages on your phone. Your report stays with our helpers. Send STATUS and your code any time.
lang_question: Which language is easiest? 1 Luganda 2 Runyankore 3 Swahili 4 English
lang_saved: Thank you. We will use {language} when we can.
danger_again: Call {helpline} now, it is free. A person is coming to help. Case {code}.
checkin: Habari: case {code}. Are you safe now? Reply 1 Yes 2 No 3 I need help
checkin_again: Habari: we are still here for you. Are you safe? Reply 1 Yes 2 No
checkin_rate: We are glad you are safe. How did we do? Reply 1 Good 2 OK 3 Not good
rating_saved: Thank you for telling us. Send HELP any time.
not_safe: Thank you for telling us. A person will contact you soon. If you are in danger call {helpline}, it is free.

replies.read: We have read your message. A helper is with you. You are not in trouble.
replies.safe_actions: Please stop replying to them, do not pay anything, and do not delete the messages. Save the username.
replies.counsellor: A counsellor will contact you today. If you are in danger call {helpline}, it is free.
replies.more_info: Thank you. If you can, tell us the username or number of the person, and when it started.
